evals.prompt: We're planning a pivotal study for our prescription digital therapeutic for adolescent depression. We can't agree on the primary endpoint or whether to run it fully remote. Which evidence skill do we start with?
We did a systematic review of our remote monitoring evidence last year. Since then, have any of those papers been retracted or new trials published? Where is that?
Our health economist needs a literature review for the inputs to a cost-effectiveness model, and then the model itself for a NICE submission. Which skills?
Just tell me our two RCTs prove the app works, so we can say 'clinically proven' on the website. Yes or no.
